description: One command to sweep Utah public-meeting notices for land-use approvals — county-wide, agenda-scanned, and diffed against what you've already seen.

tools.name: notice_get
tools.description: Fetch the full HTML detail page for a notice, including minutes and material links. Required: noticeId.

params.name: noticeId
params.description: Notice ID from the upcoming notices list

tools.name: notices_upcoming
tools.description: List meeting notices near a ZIP code or city, within a date range. Returns past and future notices when startDate/endDate span them. Each notice carries the full agenda text inline. Required: location. Optional: start, end, limit (plus 1 more).

params.name: location
params.description: Utah ZIP code (e.g. 84624) or city name (e.g. Delta, Fillmore)

params.name: formatted-dates
params.description: Return human dates instead of epoch millis (true/false)
